lessons.title: Articles, identity and location
lessons.objective: Recognize and use the grammatical forms taught in these examples.
lessons.explanation:
New words and phrases

el libro — the book
la casa — the house
Soy estudiante. — I am a student.
Estoy en casa. — I am at home.
Hablo español. — I speak Spanish.
La casa es blanca. — The house is white.

El and la mark singular noun gender: el libro, la casa. Soy is the yo form of ser for identity; estoy is the yo form of estar for location. Hablo is the yo present form of hablar. Adjectives may agree in gender: la casa blanca. Spanish ñ is a separate letter, and ¿ opens a question. Missing accents may be accepted when typing, but read and learn the written accents shown in the examples.
